title: Vulkar
extract:
The Vulkar is a Grineer sniper rifle used by Grineer Ballistas and sometimes used by Grineer Wardens. It mainly utilizes  Impact damage and has a very high status chance, making a fair amount of shots inflict status procs.
This weapon can be sold for  7,500.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Impact damage.
Three zoom modes:
First zoom has 2.5x zoom distance and +35% headshot damage.
Second zoom has 4.0x zoom distance and +55% headshot damage.
Third zoom has 8.0x zoom distance and +70% headshot damage.
Staggers most enemies with every hit.
Can use the Vulkar-exclusive  Lasting Purity and  Meticulous Aim mods.
Purity effect from  Lasting Purity can cause a screen shake, disrupting aiming.
Advantages over other Primary  Sniper Rifle weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Low recoil.
Pinpoint accuracy while zoomed in; shots will hit exactly on the reticle dot, perfect for headshots.
Innate 1 meter punch through.
Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Above average total damage (225)
Very high ammo max (72)
Above average status chance (25.00%)
Very high disposition (●●●●● (1.45x))
Disadvantages over other Primary  Sniper Rifle weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Has linear damage falloff from 100% to 50% from 400m to 600m target distance (distances are affected by Projectile Speed).
Inaccurate when fired from the hip, bullets may widely spread when fired.
Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Very low active falloff slope (400.0m/%)
Low crit chance (20.00%)
Very low burst DPS (405)
Very low sustained DPS (231.42)
Below average magazine size (6)
Very low fire rate (1.50 attacks/sec)
Very low ammo pickup (15)
Very low accuracy (0.00° to 15.00°)
Below average reload speed (3.00 s)
Low damage per shot (270)

Acquisition
The Vulkar's blueprint can be purchased from the Market. Alternatively, it can be acquired from completing the Mars to Ceres Junction.

Notes
The Vulkar has the second longest shot combo reset time of the sniper rifles at 5 seconds, thus it can maintain its shot combo after reloading.
It needs only 2 shots to initiate the shot combo counter's 1.5x damage bonus, allowing it to attain 2.0x bonus damage if all rounds of its magazine hit.
The Vulkar, alongside the  Snipetron, has the smallest minimum zoom magnification of the sniper rifles, with its minimum zoom having only 2.5x magnification. This makes the Vulkar more effective at shooting at closer range than other sniper rifles.

Tips
Use a short-ranged sidearm to compensate for closer targets.
Try to aim for the head or other vulnerable points, take your time. Spraying and praying with this weapon does not work well, as with all snipers.
Adding a maxed rank  Wildfire will give the Vulkar 1 extra bullet, while a maxed rank  Magazine Warp will add 2 extra shots. A maxed  Tainted Mag will add 4 shots, and all of these mods will total up in a magazine capacity of 13.
Maxed  Point Strike and  Vital Sense mods work well with this weapon because of its good critical chance and damage.
Use the  Sniper Ammo Mutation mod to greatly relieve the low total ammo or  Sniper Scavenger to increase the amount of sniper rifle ammo picked up. Bring along Squad Ammo Restores or use Carrier's Ammo Case.
 Rupture or  Crash Course are the most effective physical mods to use, as they increase Vulkar's already decent  Impact damage further. In combination they will grant a total of +210%  Impact damage.
 Heavy Caliber can be used on the Vulkar with little noticeable effect on its long-range accuracy, as its slow rate of fire ensures that its shots will always land on its crosshair. Heavy Caliber will affect the spread of additional bullets created by  Split Chamber however.

Trivia
It seems the Vulkar's name is based on "Vulcan", the god of fire, the forge, and the volcanoes in Roman mythology.
